thread:
incident-bot: PAGER: billing.metering.alert - token_count_anomaly (sev: high) -- affected: ingest-prod, windowing-service. Link: https://redwood/ops/incidents/INC-2026-042
oncall-amber: acked. jumping in. pinging SRE + billing. :rotating_light:
sre-nitin: thanks. looking at heartbeat and emitter metrics now. initial signs: emitter lag on consumer-lag > 30s, and token_count delta ramping between windowed aggregates.
eng-kim: I can join - I pushed a small change to the emitter config last night (batch_size bump). rolling back to previous config might reduce burstiness. grabbing runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-emit-issues
billing-elaine: customers are seeing overage flags in the billing dashboard for a subset of accounts (mostly high ingest). we need quick mitigation and customer comms if this persists.
oncall-amber: SRE, what's the customer impact surface? do we have false positive overage flags or actual double-counting?
sre-nitin: looks like double-counting on a small shard caused by consumer replays + batch overlaps. the ingest pipeline replay dedupe isn't firing for ~10% of windows. DELTA shows ~2-3x tokens for some sessions.
eng-kim: confirming: the change to batch_size caused overlapping commit windows in windowing-service. replays + delayed acks => duplicates. rolling batch_size back now.
ops-bot: run: kubectl -n metering rollout restart deployment/windowing-service --requester oncall-amber
oncall-amber: running restart now, will monitor logs. tailing aggregator logs:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z windowing-service[aggregator] window_start=164760 token_delta=1200 commit_id=abc123
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z consumer-proxy[0] ack_delay=42ms replay=true session=xyZ
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z windowing-service[aggregator] duplicate_detect=false
```
eng-kim: rollback applied. also applying a hotfix to dedupe rule to tolerate short overlapping batches (patch id: hotfix/dedupe-guard-0318)
sre-nitin: monitoring metrics: consumer-lag dropping from 36s -> 6s, token_delta tail flattening. setting temporary alert threshold higher to avoid noise while we confirm fix.
billing-elaine: are we still emitting overage flags? If yes we should bulk retract notifications for affected customers.
pm-jasper: (pm) we've got a Slack escalation to trust & safety and CS. Jasper and Elaine coordinate comms if this persists.
billing-elaine: quick query to find impacted accounts:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(token_delta) as tokens, COUNT(*) as windows
FROM metering.window_aggregates
WHERE window_time >= '2026-03-18T13:45:00Z' AND token_delta > 1000
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 50;
```
billing-elaine: results show ~42 accounts with spike; top 5 are customer-x, customer-y, customer-z. I've flagged them in our ticketing system.
oncall-amber: immediate mitigation: (1) rollback applied, (2) enable emitter backpressure to damp bursts, (3) start targeted replay suppression for windows with replay=true. Eng and SRE take.
eng-kim: enabled emitter backpressure (config toggled: max_inflight=8 -> 4). also deployed replay suppression rule: if replay && last_commit < 5s ignore_increment.
sre-nitin: metrics update: duplicates tailing off. token-count variance across windows now within expected thresholds. delayed usage reports: backend backlog still has ~12m window of delayed writes; starting backfill job now: `python tools/backfill_windows.py --from 2026-03-18T13:30Z --to 2026-03-18T14:30Z`.
billing-elaine: will hold all overage alerts until backfill completes and we can reconcile. prepping a short customer note: "We observed transient duplicated meter events due to an ingestion pipeline overlap; counts are being reconciled and false overage flags will be retracted. ETA: ~30-45m." :hourglass:
pm-jasper: create post-incident task to add a validation gate in billing pipeline to detect >2x spikes per window and auto-suppress alerts. assign to eng-kim + billing-elaine.
oncall-amber: timeline + next steps: monitor for 30m post-backfill, confirm no new duplicates, then triage follow-up for root cause and runbook updates. who owns postmortem doc?
eng-kim: I'll draft the postmortem. will include commit + deploy times and config diff. ETA EOD.
sre-nitin: keeping alerts suppressed for noise. logs look clean. consumer-lag stabilized.
ops-bot: job backfill completed successfully (duration: 00:28:12). affected write window reconciled: 99% similarity with gold ledger
billing-elaine: confirmed retraction submitted for the 42 accounts. CS to follow up individually if they saw alerts.
oncall-amber: excellent. marking incident as mitigated. switching to recovery mode. opening follow-up ticket INC-2026-042-FUP for detailed RCA and runbook updates.
pm-jasper: will coordinate downstream comms. thanks all for quick response. :pray:
eng-kim: actionable items: 1) add validation gate in billing (kim) 2) add chaos tests for batch overlap (sre-nitin) 3) revert/guard config change workflow (engineering config owners).
sre-nitin: leaving monitoring hooks for 24h and will set auto-escalation if counts deviate more than 10%.
oncall-amber: closing thread in 1h unless noise reappears. good job team. :tada:
